faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about VISUAR
faq.a1: VISUAR is a comprehensive vision testing and screening application designed to provide accessible, AI-powered vision assessment. It combines vision tracking, eye movement analysis, and clinical data analysis to support vision health research.
faq.q2: How accurate are the vision tests?
faq.a2: Our tests use advanced eye-tracking technology and AI analysis to provide reliable results. However, VISUAR is not a replacement for professional eye exams. Always consult with an eye care professional for accurate diagnosis.
faq.a3: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption and security measures. Your personal and health data are protected and stored securely. We never share your data with third parties without consent.
faq.a4: No special equipment is needed. You just need a computer or device with a webcam and an internet connection. The app uses your device's camera for eye tracking.
faq.q5: How long does a test take?
faq.a5: A complete vision assessment typically takes 10-15 minutes depending on the tests selected. Individual tests take 2-5 minutes each.
faq.a6: Yes, you can retake tests anytime. We recommend spacing tests a few days apart for the most accurate comparison of your vision health over time.
faq.q7: What does the AI analysis provide?
faq.a7: The AI analysis provides clinical findings, personalized recommendations, and a summary of your test results. It helps identify potential vision issues and suggests lifestyle changes that may help.
faq.a8: Currently, VISUAR is optimized for desktop and tablet use. Mobile support is being developed for future releases.
faq.q9: How do I download my test results?
faq.a9: After completing a test, you can view detailed results and download them as a PDF report from the results page.
faq.a10: VISUAR currently supports English and Urdu. More languages will be added in future updates.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Content: At VISUAR, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application and website.
privacy.section2Content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as email, name, health information, and profile data. We also automatically collect technical information like IP address, browser type, and device information.
privacy.section3Item1: To provide and improve our services
privacy.section3Item3: To send you updates and announcements
privacy.section4Content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.section5Content1: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business.
privacy.section5Content2: We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights and the rights of our users.
privacy.section6Content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacy.section7Item1: Right to access your personal data
privacy.section7Item3: Right to request deletion of data
privacy.section8Content: Your health and vision data are treated as sensitive information with enhanced privacy protections. We comply with all applicable health data regulations.
privacy.section9Content: VISUAR is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If we discover we have collected information from a child, we will promptly delete it.
privacy.section10Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page with an updated effective date.
